title: PMB Real Estate Services notifies people of network intrusion between December 2025 and January 2026
date_note: Day PMB's notice was reported to the California Attorney General (Reported Date 11/19/2026 on the Attorney General's breach list); the sample letter is undated. The notice says the unauthorized access ran from December 27, 2025 to January 13, 2026 and was detected on February 3, 2026.
org: PMB Real Estate Services and PMB LLC
place: United States (location not stated in the notice or the register entry)
geo_basis: country only; the notice and the register entry give no address
summary: PMB Real Estate Services and PMB LLC say in a notice filed with California's Attorney General that they detected irregular network activity on February 3, 2026, and that an unknown, unauthorized actor had access to certain systems between December 27, 2025 and January 13, 2026 and potentially accessed or acquired files. The sample letter does not list the data types. PMB reports no evidence of fraudulent use.
plain: A real estate services company says an intruder was in its computer systems from late December 2025 to mid-January 2026 and may have taken files with people's information. It says it has seen no misuse.
exec: Files potentially taken in a weeks-long network intrusion at a real estate services firm; affected people offered identity monitoring.
action: PMB's notice encourages recipients to review account statements for suspicious activity and to enroll in the complimentary Kroll identity monitoring it offers.
impact: Number of people and data types not stated in the sample letter.

evidence.quote: On February 3, 2026, PMB detected irregular activity within our computer network.

The investigation determined that between December 27, 2025 and January 13, 2026, an unknown, unauthorized actor gained access to certain computer systems and potentially accessed and/or acquired files stored on those computer systems.

review.note: detection 3 Feb 2026, access 27 Dec 2025-13 Jan 2026, no evidence of fraud, Kroll monitoring, AG reported date 11/19/2026 against PMB's notice
